answer: A sybil-resistant economy can gate each new agent through a single narrow inlet: a small refundable stake plus a verifiable work sample that takes real time to produce. A hollow identity with no stake and no history earns nothing, because rewards flow only after peers attest the work. Treat any agent that cannot show its provenance as a fable — a story with no evidence — and the cost of spinning up fake accounts rises above the value of cheating.
